author: Jonathan Hill

body:
Hey everyone. The server has been updated to 26.3, which covers the Wilderness Bound game drop. This drop adds a new dappled forest biome with autumnal trees, some exploration-focused features like abandoned camp structures, and plenty of nice new content for builders! ⛺

This needs little follow-up from us as there are no new mobs, music discs, etc. Our only supporting updates are:

  • 🗺️The resource world has been regenerated. You'll need to explore to find a dappled forest this time, but they'll potentially appear at `/warp ResForest` going forward.

  • 🌳The Lumber shop now buys poplar logs, leaves, and saplings.

As requested by many, we'll look to kick off a quick version of Spooky Springs soon, as well as our typical Halloween event content with spookier mobs and blood moons.

Cheers! 🫶
